implication: Filing of Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a gating procedural requirement when an acquirer crosses 15% or more (or certain thresholds) of a target's shares; practitioners must verify the specific stake acquired and whether open offer obligations are triggered under Regulation 37.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: central – Acquirer must disclose substantial acquisition of shares within the prescribed timeline and manner to the stock exchange.
central – Open offer obligation triggered if acquirer crosses 25% (or acquires additional 5% in 12 months after crossing 25%) of total shareholding.
central – Defines 'Acquisition' and sets thresholds (15%, 25%) triggering disclosure.

amended – Acquirer and target must disclose material information (acquisition, stake increase) to exchanges and shareholders.
central – Scope and applicability; exemptions (if any) for specific acquisition structures.
amended – If acquirer is foreign, FDI/FPI reporting and approval may be triggered.
